 Robert Marvi Lakers Wire Oct. 25, 2026, 10:01 a.m. ET Hear this story The Los Angeles Lakers visit the Utah Jazz on Sunday, and if you're wondering how you can watch all the action live, you've come to the right place.
 This will be the first road game of the new season for the Lakers, who defeated the Golden State Warriors 127-105 on Wednesday and the Los Angeles Clippers 125-117 on Friday to start with a 2-0 record. Their offense has shown promise despite plenty of problems with turnovers, and their defense, while certainly imperfect, looks more aggressive than it has in a few years.
 Utah, after missing the playoffs in each of the last four seasons, appears to have a young and talented roster that could compete for a spot in this spring's play-in tournament. It has recent All-Stars Jaren Jackson Jr. and Lauri Markkanen on its frontline, perhaps a soon-to-be All-Star in guard Keyonte George and a promising rookie in guard Darryn Peterson. It has a 1-1 record after sneaking past the New Orleans Pelicans on Friday.
 This will mark a return for new Lakers center Walker Kessler, as well as Lakers guard Collin Sexton. Kessler spent the last four seasons in Utah, and Sexton was there with him for the first three of those campaigns before he was traded to the Charlotte Hornets in the summer of 2025.
 Here's how to watch the Lakers game, including time, TV schedule and streaming information:
